local-ai-html: Third attempt. Attempt 1 (2026-11-21 20:10 UTC) was killed by the out-of-memory killer: 8k context, 4 GB resident on a shared machine. Attempt 2 was stopped by hand: the model wrote its first call as a pretty-printed <tool_call> text block that node-llama-cpp did not detect, and the loop of that version could not run it. Fixes: 4k context, shorter tool descriptions, and the loop runs text-format calls; in this run every call came as such a text block. Under heavy machine load the first attempts needed about 17 minutes to the first tool call; this run (lighter load) took 4.2 minutes in all. The studio was commit 02817d3; the agent loop had the text-call and 4k-context changes that were committed next (d9642bf), but not yet the context reset or the smaller tool set.
local-ai-hyperframes: Second attempt. Attempt 1 (2026-11-21 21:07 UTC) rendered the reel but never finished: the model called get_job_logs instead of get_job, the long log overflowed the 4k context and node-llama-cpp threw. Fixes: get_job_logs is no longer offered to the local model, and the session restarts with a recap when the context is full. In this run the model made six native tool calls, one per turn. The reply recorded above is the loop's own abort after get_render_output returned (it stops generation once the render is fetched); that also lost the turn count. The loop now stops cleanly there.
rest-multi-engine: Second run. The first run failed because the HyperFrames scene stopped on low disk space (0.7 GB free on the shared machine); see TUT-30.
